arabic text: LAHOO MEIN DOOBE YEH KARBALA HAIN
english translation text: THIS IS KARBALA, SOAKED IN BLOOD

arabic text: LAHOO MEIN DOOBE YEH KARBALA HAIN\nJAVAN LASHO SE DASHTE SARA BHARA HOWA HAI\nHAI YEH KARBALA HAI
english translation text: THIS IS KARBALA, SOAKED IN BLOOD,\nTHE WHOLE DESERT IS FULL OF YOUNG BODIES,\nTHIS IS KARBALA, THIS IS KARBALA.

arabic text:
ALAM JO KAHLI HUSSEIN LAYE
HARAM YEH SAMJEH ABBAS AIYE
HAR EK BASHA ALAM SE RO KAR
LIPAT GAYYA HAIN
english translation text: WHEN HUSAIN BROUGHT THE A’LAM (FLAG) ALONE,\nTHE CHILDREN THOUGHT ABBAS HAD COME,\nEVERY CHILD CLUNG TO THE A’LAM (FLAG) AND WEPT.

arabic text:
SAGIR ASGAR KO TEER MARE
CHENE SAKINA KE GOSH VARE
YE KAISE ZULM AUR BHAR BHIRYAAT
KI INTAHA HAI
english translation text: THEY SHOT THE BABY ALI ASGHAR WITH AN ARROW,\nAND SNATCHED AWAY SAKINA'S EARRINGS FROM HER,\nTHIS IS THE HEIGHT OF INJUSTICE AND BARBARISM

arabic text:
RABAAB CHEEKI KOIEE TO AIYE
UTHA KE BIMAR KO JO LAYE
KOIEE LUTHERA HAMARE KHAMEIN
JHALLA RAHA HAIN
english translation text: RUBAB SHOUTED, SOMEONE PLEASE COME\nAND CARRY SAJJAD, WHO IS UNWELL,\nSOME VILLAINS ARE BURNING OUR TENTS.

arabic text:
MERI NAVASE BE BERIDA HAIN
MERA NAVASA BHI BE KAFAN HAI
RASOOL RO RO KE AMBIYA KO
BHATA RAHA HAI
english translation text: 'MY GRANDDAUGHTER IS WITHOUT A VEIL,\nAND MY GRANDSON IS WITHOUT A SHROUD',\nPROPHET (PBUH) IS TELLING THE OTHER PROPHETS, AND WEEPING.

arabic text:
NA DAIR MAQTAL MAIN AB LAGAWO
CHALLA KEIN GALLDI ASSIR LAWO
LAIYEEN ABID KO TAIZEYANE
LAGA RAHA HAI
english translation text: DO NOT TAKE LONG IN THE BATTLEFIELD NOW,\nWALK QUICKLY AND BRING THE CAPTIVES,\nTHE ACCURSED MAN IS WHIPPING SAJJAD.

arabic text:
YE KHOON NE NA HAQ NA CHUP SAKE GA
KABI YE MATAM NA
RUKE TO PHIR KARBALA BANE GE
YE FASILA HAIN
english translation text:
ROK SAKE GA
THIS BLOOD THAT WAS SPILT UNJUSTLY WILL NEVER STAY HIDDEN,
THIS MATAM WILL NEVER BE STOPPED,
IF IT IS STOPPED, THEN THERE WILL BE ANOTHER KARBALA, THIS IS THE DECISION.
